```{r init}
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

SITE <- params$SITE
PATH <- params$DROPBOX
CURRENT <- "current_data"

if(SITE %in% c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC", "SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW", "DLG")) {
  SUBPATH <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
} else if(site %in% c("TMP")) {
  SUBPATH <- "TEMPEST_PNNL_Data"
  CURRENT <- "Current_data" # you're killing me, Roy
} else {
  stop("Unknown site: ", site)
}

```

Data path: `r PATH`

Data folder: `r SUBPATH`

Current data: `r CURRENT`

```{r helpers}
#| include: false

no_data_check <- function(x, what) {
  message(nrow(x), " data rows")
  if(nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat('::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}',
        '## No Data',
        '',
        paste('No data files were found for', what),
        '',
        ':::', sep = "\n")
  }
}

read_files <- function(type,
                       site = SITE, 
                       path = PATH,
                       subpath = SUBPATH,
                       current = CURRENT) {

  files <- list.files(file.path(path, subpath, current), 
                      pattern = paste0("_", site, "_.*_", type),
                      full.names = TRUE)
  message("Found ", length(files), " files")
  
  x <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    txt <- read_lines(f)
    read_csv(I(txt[c(-1, -3, -4)]), show_col_types = FALSE)
  })
  names(x) <- basename(files)
  x %>% 
    bind_rows()
}
```

# Sapflow

```{r sf-read}
#| output: "asis"
sf <- read_files("Sapflow")
no_data_check(sf, "Sapflow")
```

```{r sf-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
if(nrow(sf) > 0) {
  sf %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-4) %>% 
    filter(name != "BattV_Avg") %>%  # we probably don't care about this
    separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site", "Plot")) %>% 
    mutate(port = gsub("DiffVolt._Avg\\(", "", name),
           port = as.integer(gsub(")", "", port)),
           port = as.factor(port)) -> 
    sf
  
  p <- ggplot(sf, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
    facet_grid(Plot ~ .) +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
  print(p)
  
  p <- p + ylim(c(0, 1)) + ggtitle("Data in 0-1 range only")
  print(p)
}
```

```{r sf-table}
if(nrow(sf) > 0) {
  sf %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>% 
    group_by(Site, Plot_PB, port) %>%
    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>% 
    knitr::kable()
}
```

# TEROS

```{r teros-read}
#| output: "asis"
teros <- read_files("Teros") 
no_data_check(teros, "TEROS")
```

```{r teros-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
if(nrow(teros) > 0) {
  teros %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-4) %>% 
    filter(name != "BattV_Avg") %>%  # we probably don't care about this
    separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site", "Plot")) %>% 
    mutate(name = gsub("Teros.\\(", "", name),
           name = gsub(")", "", name)) %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("port", "sensor"), convert = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(sensor_name = case_when(
      sensor == "1" ~ "EC",
      sensor == "2" ~ "T",
      sensor == "3" ~ "VWC"
    )) -> 
    teros
  
  p <- ggplot(teros, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
    facet_grid(sensor_name ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
  print(p)
}
```

```{r teros-table}
if(nrow(teros) > 0) {
  teros %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>% 
    group_by(Site, Plot_PB, port) %>%
    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>% 
    knitr::kable()
}
```

# AquaTROLL

```{r troll-read}
#| output: "asis"
troll <- read_files("WaterLevel")
no_data_check(troll, "AquaTROLL")
```

```{r troll-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll %>% 
    select(-starts_with("Aquatroll")) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-4) %>% 
    separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site", "Plot")) %>% 
    mutate(troll = substr(name, nchar(name), nchar(name)),
           name = substr(name, 1, nchar(name) - 1)) ->
    troll
  
  for(nm in unique(troll$name)) {
    x <- filter(troll, name == nm)
    p <- ggplot(x, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = troll)) +
      facet_grid(name ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r troll-table}
if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>% 
    group_by(Site, Plot_PB, troll) %>%
    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>% 
    knitr::kable()
}
```
